title: Nvidia to invest up to $10B in Anthropic

sources.quote: As part of the partnership, NVIDIA and Microsoft are committing to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively in Anthropic.
In November 2025, we entered into an agreement, subject to certain closing conditions, to invest up to $10 billion in Anthropic.

explain: Nvidia agreed to invest up to $10 billion in Anthropic, subject to closing conditions, as part of a three-way deal in which Anthropic will run Claude on Nvidia systems in Microsoft's cloud.
